text.p: Intelligent Electronics Inc said Friday it has completed the sale of the majority of its direct computer sales operations, XLSource, to General Electric Co's General Electric Capital Information Technology Solutions unit.
Also, the company said its 80-percent-owned unit XLConnect Solutions Inc has sold certain related contracts and assets to GE Capital I.T.S.
The total purchase price was about $136 million paid in cash, with Intelligent Electronics retaining certain liabilities, it said.

Some of the purchase price has been put in escrow pending the receipt of third-party consents, it said. Intelligent Electronics is retaining direct computer sales operations in Cincinnati, Cleveland, Pittsburgh and Indianapolis.
Revenues of the retained operations, which will continue to function in a partnership relationship with XLConnect, were about $200 million during fiscal 1996, it said.

"Going forward, the company will focus on providing professional services through XLConnect and on supporting the remaining XLSource operations and will have the ability to serve as a single source to clients," company chairman and chief executive officer Richard Sanford said in a statement.

"In addition, XLConnect and GE Capital I.T.S. have agreed to provide joint selling opportunities between the organizations," Sanford said. "Our efforts are intended to return the Company to profitability, with IE's balance sheet substantially strengthened."

It is anticipated that this acquisition will provide GE Capital I.T.S. with the opportunity to develop an ongoing business relationship with XLConnect and extend GE Capital Solution's global deployment capabilities and comprehensive Life Cycle services to an expanded national account base.
